featured_reviews.name: Alok Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kothari Sweets or Farsan is not the real name. The real name is Mulund Farsan, and Kothari is actually the name of the property where this shop is located. Hence it has been popular by the name of Kothari since ages. Soo much that even the family members who have opened different branches are going by the same brand, kothari.
It is a go to shop for almost all the residents of Mulund because of it's quality and taste. But off late since the next generation has taken up the responsibility, the taste and quality seems to be compromised. Other establishments have got the advantage of this situation. Old timers still find this to be the first choice to visit, but how long they will be able to pull this is something everybody is saying wait and watch.

If I must make a suggestion, i would advise the current generation who are handling the operations, to pull up your socks before you become a choice and not the priority

featured_reviews.name: Vinod jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mahalaxmi Sweet Shop in Mulund is a culinary gem that tantalizes taste buds with its exquisite array of traditional Indian sweets and snacks. Renowned for its authentic flavors and high-quality ingredients, this sweet shop has become a beloved destination for those with a penchant for delectable treats.

Upon entering Mahalaxmi Sweet Shop, one is greeted by the aroma of freshly prepared sweets that evoke a sense of nostalgia. From the iconic Mysore Pak to the delicate Rasgullas, each offering reflects a commitment to time-honored recipes and impeccable craftsmanship. The shop's commitment to quality extends to its cleanliness and hygiene standards, ensuring a delightful and safe culinary experience for patrons.

What sets Mahalaxmi Sweet Shop apart is not only its sweets but also its diverse range of savory snacks. From crunchy samosas to flavorful chaats, the savory selection complements the sweetness of the desserts perfectly. The courteous staff adds to the overall pleasant ambiance, providing attentive service to customers.

Whether indulging in a box of assorted sweets for celebrations or simply stopping by for a quick snack, Mahalaxmi Sweet Shop in Mulund consistently delivers on taste, variety, and authenticity. It stands as a testament to the rich culinary heritage of India, leaving patrons with a memorable and satisfying gastronomic experience.

featured_reviews.name: Pratham k
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent visit to Brijwasi Sweets left much to be desired, particularly with their rendition of Malai Rabri.
The Malai Rabri lacked the essence of rabri altogether. Instead of the creamy richness and subtle sweetness characteristic of this dessert, I was met with a disappointing concoction that seemed to have been assembled from leftover materials of Mawa Pedha. The texture was excessively grainy, ingredients hastily thrown together. most disheartening was the absence of malai, the very essence that gives Malai Rabri its name and identity.  Brijwasi Sweets has missed the mark when it comes to crafting authentic Malai Rabri.

featured_reviews.name: Kirit Manek
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought 6 pieces of Malai sandwich today morning at 10.30 AM after confirming with them that it is indeed freshly made.
I kept it in my fridge soon after reaching home in about 10 minutes.
I removed it from my fridge to consume it at 12.30 noon and the cream had turned sour.
Obviously it was not a 'fresh' ; lucky that I had no food poisoning.
Never am i stepping again in that shop nor would I recommend anyone to do so.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Satkar Sweets and Snacks and was deeply disappointed by my experience, primarily due to severe hygiene and mismanagement issues.

Upon entering, we noticed Deepu, the staff member assigned to our order of garlic bread with corn, brooming the shop. While cleanliness is crucial in any food establishment, it was concerning to see him transition directly from sweeping the floor to food preparation without proper sanitation protocols.

Despite washing his hands post-brooming, Deepu proceeded to make our order without wearing gloves. When we requested that he put on gloves, he showed utter disappointment, which was both unprofessional and troubling. He placed the bread in his hand and then, with the other hand, began scooping cheese from a container, exposing our food to potential contamination.

When we asked to cancel our order and requested a refund, the staff reacted poorly, creating a scene rather than addressing our concerns professionally. This escalated further when my mother approached the owner for assistance. Instead of offering a solution, he disrespected her, which added to our frustration.

The overall experience at Satkar Sweets and Snacks was marred by inadequate hygiene practices and unprofessional behavior. It’s crucial for any eatery to prioritize cleanliness and customer service, and unfortunately, this establishment fell short in both areas. I cannot recommend Satkar Sweets and Snacks based on this experience.

featured_reviews.name: Moumita S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sweet Bengal is a popular chain of sweet shops known for its authentic Bengali sweets and snacks. It was founded by restaurateur Anjan Chatterjee, who is also the force behind Speciality Restaurants Limited

The idea for Sweet Bengal was born out of Chatterjee's homesickness for authentic Bengali mishti (sweets) after moving to Mumbai in the 1990s. Instead of simply making the sweets for himself, he saw a business opportunity in serving a larger community that shared his passion for traditional Bengali delicacies. Since then, Sweet Bengal has established a reputation for its authentic taste, quality ingredients, and hygiene, with numerous outlets across Mumbai, Pune, and Thane

Sweet Bengal shops feature winter specials made with nolen gur (date palm jaggery), a seasonal ingredient available only from November to January. Popular winter sweets include nolen gurer sandesh, baked rosogolla with nolen gur, many more delicacies along with nolen gur in pot. These sweets are known for their unique smoky, caramelized flavors and evoke a sense of nostalgia and tradition

Sweet Bengal is known for both traditional sweets and some innovative creations

Sweet Bengal emphasizes using high-quality and fresh ingredients, especially milk, which is crucial for authentic Bengali sweets. The chain takes pride in maintaining hygiene standards and uses visually appealing packaging for its products, making them popular for gifting

Sweet Bengal plays a significant cultural role for the Bengali diaspora living outside Kolkata, especially in Mumbai

Perfect place to get absolutely clean and delicious sweets. The place is not only a go to for sweets but also serves mouthwatering snacks.
Although there is no place to sit, and one has to stand and eat right in front of shop; the delicious sabudana wada, batata wada, kachori and other limited menu items (availability subject to the day wise menu) shall make your mouth water. Rates are moderately higher than the general standard rates for the said items, but the exquisite taste shall not make you remorse.
The typical Maharashtrian staples of kitchen goods likes of different types of flours and savouries are also available (at good rates). All in all cross of hotel, sweets shop and grocery store in definitely one to visit

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Khandekar
featured_reviews.review_text: If you are looking for authentic Maharashtrian sweets as well as dishes, this is one of the best places. They do not serve meals as their name suggests. Located near Mulund station on East side and very friendly owner you get good many sweets. Do not miss.

featured_reviews.name: Dad Doo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had heard a lot about this place, so when I was in Mulund East I visited the place.
I had eaten their Vadapav. The pav was soft & fresh and the vada was piping hot & tasty but their red dry chutney was not at all spicy. ₹23 for vadapav is bit pricey.

Ambience is absolutely zero as it is on the busy station road market & has no place to sit & enjoy the food.
Even water for washing hands was missing.

It is a typical Maharashtrian snacks eatery with old furniture & slow staff.
I didn't understand why is it a bhojnalaya when only few food items are available daily, rest others like kothimbir wadi, thalipeeth are available on specific days.

Although I tasted their Vadapav only, I am pretty sure that rest ALL items will be tasty.
I will definitely visit again & try the other items too.

featured_reviews.name: ganesh koyande
featured_reviews.review_text: I love jalebi here so I always come from Thane to buy. But in my last purchase I got a fly extra along with jalebi. The fly was fully fried and crisp and was inside the jalebi. From next time onwards I doubt I will buy from here.

featured_reviews.name: atul baride
featured_reviews.review_text: Maharashtrian Food Speciality Sweet Shop.. Shop has fixed and limited working time 9.00 AM to 1.00 PM & 4 PM to 8.30 PM. Despite Name its not a eatery and not a restaurant. Eat on street or carry home traditional items.

featured_reviews.name: YOGESH D
featured_reviews.review_text: Great place for buying Testy Diwali Faral (Chiwda, Ladoo, Karnaji, Chakli and so on) and Sweets and Upwaas items and snacks options. We are buying from here for last 30 years and the authentic Marathi test is maintained very well.

Hariom quickly became the go-to destination for sweets and treats.
What began with a small customer base gradually grew into a large and loyal com-munity.
Today, 27 years later, the second generation has taken the helm, carrying forward the legacy.

Our vision remains the same to preserve tradition and authenticity while embracing modern times.
Hariom offers sweets & snacks that embody tradition, flavor, authenticity, and purity.

featured_reviews.name: manish chandramore
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience. The sweets and snacks were tasty, and had good quality. Loved the wide variety of options available, especially the chaat and fast food items. The ambiance is nice for a quick bite with family and friends. Service was quick even during rush hours. Definitely one of the best sweet shops in Mulund for sweets, snacks, and evening cravings.

featured_reviews.name: Bharati Poojary
featured_reviews.review_text: Hariom Sweets is simply divine! 🤩 Each sweet is a masterpiece, bursting with authentic flavors. Their commitment to quality shines through in every bite. I can't recommend this place enough for anyone craving traditional Indian sweets! 💖 Definitely coming back for more! 💯

featured_reviews.name: abstract pixels
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried Samosa pav, It was delicious.
First I thought this might be like just a regular Samosa pav, but it was very good and piping hot. And it just tastes better as you start eating the last part, Because of the dry chutney they put on the pav.

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Nigade
featured_reviews.review_text: This establishment consistently offers products of exceptional quality. I find it to be an outstanding destination for acquiring premium goods. Highly recommended! 💯✨👍 They have multiple branches in mulund .

featured_reviews.name: Hemant Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: Very bad food experience at Neelam nagar outlet of Hari Om sweets. Tried veg Schezwan frankie and Dry fruit falooda. But utter disappointment to taste which did not have Schezwan and falooda made by pouring milk. Pathetic to taste, unfortunately had to throw. Street vendors give good products at better cost. Think twice before spending high cost on such tasteless food and rude staff.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Bhogan
featured_reviews.review_text: Hariom used to be our go-to for savoury orders during family gatherings and special occasions. However, it’s disheartening to say that the taste has drastically changed. It’s become overhyped and the prices are exorbitant. The samosa, once a favourite, has become the worst I’ve ever had. With the increasing number of outlets, consistency in taste has become a problem. They’ve become utterly disappointed and there have been instances where the coconut chutney has gone bad. Really bad experience

featured_reviews.name: Amol Dighe
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to pickup dry snacks in Mulund East. They also have few fast food outlets serving dosa, bhel, sandwich. Dary snacks price is a bit on the higher side but the quality seem good.

featured_reviews.name: MINAL PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hari Om Angoori Peda is absolutely delicious! 😍
Soft, fresh, and perfectly sweet with a rich milky taste. The texture melts in the mouth and the quality feels premium. A must-try sweet for anyone who loves traditional Indian mithai. Highly recommended! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Abhilash Satheesan
featured_reviews.review_text: If it would have been possible i would have marked the chaats food negatively. I purchased 2 samosa’s at evening around 5 20 and got home in 10 minutes the samosa’s were too cold i just thought no worries i will just have it and after starting to eat , the inner potato stuff was stale like it was so stale that it was tasting like it was made a day ago and by seeing the outer layer i think that they have fried it twice or thrice, in such rush hours and on a auspicious day like Deepawali i was wasn’t expecting this from you. And while writing this review my mom has already vomitted twice, is this your hospitality and wasn’t expecting this from you.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Thakker
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the quality chain stores now with the presence in Mulund east and Mulund west
Hari om Dry fruits is one the premium shops for good quality of farsan and all other breakfast and Dry fruits.
You will get all good taste food like, samosa, dhokla, white dhokla, Idli, जलेबी, gathiya, Pizza all you name it and get it.
Food is also of class quality and taste.

featured_reviews.name: Meghana Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: The festive season is here so I visited Hariom Sweets in Mulund. They offer an amazing range of dry fruits, sweets, chocolates, snacks and a lot more. Wide variety of gifting items as well. Loved their packaging and quality. I tried their sweets and snacks. Hariom special cheese grilled sandwich is a must try. We also had Schezwan noodle frankie, dini dosa and dry fruit falooda. Overall experience was amazing. Definitely a must visit.

featured_reviews.name: Note & Navigate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very well food place in mulund. They have almost every types of fast food options that too tasty. Ample amount of seating area, plus easy parking.
Just the shakes are not worthy of price they are charging.

featured_reviews.name: Harshika Dedhia
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing evening snacks from here. I usually come here for their special dabeli which is quite different from the street ones specially their masalas. Dosa was nice. Their chaats are too too good. They got a quite huge range of sweets and dry snacks as well.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Firoz Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was just amazing experience visiting this place and having some tempting food.
The place is nice and quite big. One can order and have the food comfortably. You would find this place every time busy as people are always available here due to thier tempting taste
I had tried dahi kachori which was fabulous still i can feel that chaat flavor on my toung. I just loved it the way they made not much spicy not much sweet.
Gini dosa is my favorite which i loved to try it took some time but at the end got some tempting and yumm dosa delivered.
They have multiple option available in dosa will try them. Next time.
Grill sandwich was also well prepared. The chutney they served was too yumm.
One must try thier sweet dish. They make some tempting and mouthwatering sweets. Staff of the place is nice and helpfull they suggest nice dish accordingly.

Highly recommend
Food ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Ambience⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Staff ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.name: Rosy Kohli
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice variety of sweets ,Good shop on the road side ,lot of variety staff is good. Samosa, Dhokala, are yummy. Had at friends place who stays just opposite bldg. Gulab jamun was awesome. We all friends enjoyed eating it.
